sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Treaty stream (Tuvalu) is available to eligible citizens of Tuvalu.

We have allocated up to 280 Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Treaty stream (Tuvalu) visas to eligible Tuvalu nationals in the 2026-27 Program Year.

The Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) - Treaty stream (Tuvalu) pre-application ballot for Tuvalu closed on 1 June 2026.

You can only submit an application for this visa if we selected you in a Treaty stream (Tuvalu) pre-application ballot and invited you to apply.

See:
Factsheet - Treaty stream to learn more about the Pacific Engagement visa (subclass 192) Treaty stream (Tuvalu)
